stories.h: Netanyahu grants Eisenkot security briefing after public standoff
stories.s: Caretaker PM Netanyahu agreed to brief Eisenkot on diplomatic and security matters Thursday, after Eisenkot asked the attorney general to secure regular intelligence updates. Likud also stalled Liberman's appointment as defense committee chair until Monday.

stories.h: Israeli strike on Gaza's Nasser Hospital targets Hamas commander
stories.s: An overnight strike on the Khan Younis hospital complex aimed at Hamas's local brigade commander killed at least six people, including a surgeon, Palestinian reports say. The IDF was still checking whether the commander died.

stories.h: Haredi leaders open door to talks with Eisenkot bloc
stories.s: A senior rabbi reportedly authorized ultra-Orthodox representatives to negotiate with Eisenkot's camp, though he doubts a deal. Yeshiva students' draft status is the sticking point as Haredi protesters clashed with police over arrests.

stories.h: Europeans seek emergency UN Security Council meeting on E1
stories.s: Denmark and other European states want the Council to meet next week on Israel's E1 settlement plan before a November 19 tender deadline. Israel says it is working with the US and Greece to block the session.

stories.h: Israel recalls Netherlands envoy over Ben Gvir, Smotrich criticism
stories.s: Ambassador Zvi Aviner Vapni was summoned home for clarification after telling a Dutch paper the far-right ministers' remarks were unacceptable and that violent West Bank settlers should be jailed.

coming.h: Knesset vote on Liberman as defense committee chair
coming.s: Delayed by Likud, the vote installing Liberman as temporary Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee chair is expected Monday.
The Israel Land Authority is due to open bids for 1,234 housing units in the contested E1 area east of Jerusalem.
